experiment: E16 CATIA Magic customization library: what a UML3 view palette has to build on
setup: Read-only probe tools/cameo-scripts/probeCustomizationLibrary.groovy through the harness: lists root members named DS*/Dassault*, then writes CATIA Magic's own textual notation (SysMLTextGeneratorServices.createTextualNotationBuilder().toText(namespace)) of DS_UIComponents::CoreUIComponents (Palette, Operations, Components, Dialogs), DS_Views::CoreViews, DS_Views::ViewPalettes and DS_Views::SymbolicViews to logs/cameo/ds-library/. Source for the expectations: SysML v2 Plugin UserGuide 2026x R1, 'Custom symbolic view definitions' (pp. 354-365) and 'Custom creation dialogs' (pp. 620-647).

predictions.claim: The UML3 project already contains the DS_Views and DS_UIComponents roots (the 3DS SysML Customization library is attached to SysML v2 projects by default, because the predefined symbolic views and their palettes come from it)
toText works on library namespaces and the text contains "view def <bsv> 'Base Symbolic View'" with 'part baseViewPalette : ViewPalettes::BasePalette :>> palette'
DS_UIComponents::CoreUIComponents::Palette defines Button and ButtonsCategory with the features abstractButtons, focusedButton, label, description, isCollapsed, hasVisibleLabels and representation

DS_Views::ViewPalettes::CodeActionIdentifiers holds one String attribute per predefined button (e.g. requirementAction = "ADD_REQUIREMENT"), including actions for part def, item def, attribute def, enum def, port def, connection def and metadata def
DS_UIComponents::CoreUIComponents::Operations defines OperationFromCode, OperationFromTemplate and OperationByMetaclass, each with an 'in' parameter

The General View palette (GeneralPalette) is a specialization of BasePalette whose extra categories are part usages subsetting buttonCategories, so a UML3 palette can specialize GeneralPalette and add categories
